question: Which embered path will you tread?
intro_environment: A vast, twilight expanse of ember-tinged hills, a river of molten silver winding through a forest of glowing shrubs, distant jagged peaks radiating warm amber, and a sky streaked with gold and crimson. The world feels alive with crackling embers and soft, flickering light.
intro_camera: Wide landscape camera, capturing the full breadth of the embered world with a slight tilt to emphasize depth.
intro_couple_action: A small couple, barely a silhouette, walking along a shimmering path of fireflies, their footsteps leaving tiny sparks, their heads tilted toward the horizon.

choices.title: Crimson Grove
choices.description: A dense forest where every leaf glows a deep crimson, and vines pulse with embered light. The ground is littered with glowing moss and small fireflies.
choices.composition: Diagonal sweep from the foreground vines to the distant glowing canopy.
choices.camera: Low angle, slightly tilted to capture the towering embered trees.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep reds, burgundy, dark charcoal with bright ember highlights.
choices.couple_action: The couple crouches to pick a glowing ember flower, their faces illuminated by its glow.

choices.title: Amber Cavern
choices.description: A sprawling underground cavern lit by amber crystals that refract light into a golden halo. Stalactites and stalagmites glow softly, and streams of molten gold trickle down the walls.
choices.composition: Symmetrical tunnel view with a central light source casting reflections.
choices.camera: Wide-angle interior shot, slightly above eye level to show cavern depth.
choices.dominant_palette: Amber golds, warm ochre, shadowy grays.
choices.couple_action: The couple explores a crystal chamber, one holds a crystal in hand while the other maps the interior with a torch.

choices.title: Molten Falls
choices.description: A cascading waterfall of flowing lava plunges into a churning pool of molten rock, surrounded by charred cliffs and drifting smoke.
choices.composition: Vertical composition emphasizing the height of the lava fall, with a foreground of ash.
choices.camera: High angle bird's eye, capturing the full scale of the falls and surrounding terrain.
choices.dominant_palette: Bright orange, molten red, ash gray, and smoky black.
choices.couple_action: The couple stands at the base of the falls, one with a shield of heat-resistant stone, the other with a torch reflecting off the molten surface.

choices.title: Saffron Peak
choices.description: A towering mountain peak bathed in the warm glow of a sunset, its slopes covered in saffron-colored cliffs and golden lichens, with a faint aurora of embered light swirling above.
choices.composition: Frontal view with a sweeping horizon of the peak and distant embered valleys.
choices.camera: Wide landscape shot from the base looking up, emphasizing the peak's height.
choices.dominant_palette: Saffron gold, warm ochre, deep blue twilight, ember orange.
choices.couple_action: The couple climbs a rocky ledge, one pointing toward the aurora, the other taking a photo with a torch.
